name: vscode-axiom
description: First-party thin VS Code client for Axiom (`axiomc lsp --stdio`) with AXCODEEDITOR ownership, capability, move/drop, and async suspension intelligence.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Binding whose ownership has been moved before the end of its lexical scope

axiom.lsp.serverPath.description: Path to the `axiomc` compiler binary used to launch `axiomc lsp --stdio`.

axiom.lsp.positionEncoding.description: Negotiated LSP position encoding (`utf-16` default per LSP 3.17, or `utf-8`).

axiom.lsp.inlayHints.inferredTypes.description: Enable AXCODEEDITOR inferred type inlay hints (`: Type`) on unannotated `let` bindings.

axiom.lsp.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Enable AXCODEEDITOR parameter name inlay hints (`param:`) at non-trivial call arguments.

axiom.lsp.inlayHints.ownershipFlow.description: Enable AXCODEEDITOR ownership/capability flow inlay hints (`move`, `drop`, `view`, `mut_view`).

axiom.lsp.inlayHints.asyncSuspension.description: Enable AXCODEEDITOR `.await` suspension state-machine inlay hints.
